description: This Java class 'EcuDefinitionHandler' is a SAX parser handler for processing XML files that define ECU (Electronic Control Unit) configurations. It reads and extracts ECU definitions from XML elements, stores them in a map, and provides debugging details about each ECU definition.

classes.name: EcuDefinitionHandler
classes.description: A SAX parser handler class for parsing ECU XML definitions, extracting relevant data, and constructing ECU definition objects.

methods.name: startDocument
methods.description: Initializes the map for ECU definitions at the start of XML parsing.

methods.name: startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element, initializes variables depending on the tag.

methods.name: characters
methods.description: Appends character data inside XML elements into a buffer.

methods.name: endElement
methods.description: Processes completed XML elements, constructs ECU definition objects, and stores them in the map.

methods.name: getEcuDefinitionMap
methods.description: Returns the map of ECU definitions parsed from the XML.

methods.name: romDetail
methods.description: Returns a detailed string representation of the current ECU definition for logging purposes.
